outline:
本課程欲讓應用英文系學生了解改變社會結構之全球議題與趨勢。特此希望學生在參與討論的過程中，能夠產出對世界有正面效益之改善之道。課堂限制之關係，課程內容將著重於閱讀、答辯，和研討篩選後之報告及新聞，藉以達到上述之目的。
This course aims to engage English major students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.
schedule:
1	Course Introduction
2	The Global Spread of English
3	Diversity of English
4	English as a lingua franca and plurilingualism
5	SDGs Overview and Global Citizenship Competences
6	Social Justice and Educational Equality
7	Linking Global and Local Issues
8	Community Problem Investigation
9	Action Plan Stage I: Drafting
10	Action Plan Stage II: Refining
11	Action Plan Stage III: Implementing
12	Final Presentation Preparation
13	Action Plan Presentation (1)
14	Action Plan Presentation (2)
15	Action Plan Presentation (3)
16	Review of Global Citizenship Competences
17	Global Citizenship Forum
18	Final reflection
assessment:
Global Englishes and Intercultural Communication Tasks – 20%
Global Issue Analysis Report – 20%
Action Plan Design – 20%
Action Plan Presentation – 20%
Individual Reflective Report – 20%
